description: This file defines the SetupService class which implements ISetupService, providing methods for retrieving setup recipes and performing application setup operations, including database configuration, recipe execution, and shell state management in an OrchardCore application.

classes.name: SetupService
classes.description: Implements ISetupService, providing setup and configuration functionalities for OrchardCore applications.

methods.name: GetSetupRecipesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves setup recipes, harvesting them if not already loaded.

methods.name: SetupAsync
methods.description: Performs the setup process with the provided context, managing shell state and error handling.

methods.name: SetupInternalAsync
methods.description: Contains the core logic for setting up the application, including database validation, recipe execution, and shell configuration.
